text.prohibited_data_note: Scanned for shapes -- known vendor key prefixes, digit runs passing Luhn, PEM armour -- and not for wording, so writing about credentials is fine and only something formatted like one is reported. It finds neither an unfamiliar key format nor a password, which has no shape to match, so clean means those shapes are absent rather than that the set holds no secret. The gate's other half is the review in export-review.md, which runs before an export rather than inside it.
